info.title: Noosphere
info.description: Application landscape API: applications, flows, data objects, teams and domains. Guide: docs/en/api.md.

requestBody.description: An exchange file, in JSON or YAML.

sourceOf.description: Ids of the data objects whose source is this application (derived from `DataObject.sourceApplicationId`).

completeness.description: Share of the recommended fields that are filled, 0 to 1.

ApplicationDto.description: An application the reader may see in full. `restricted` is always false (true on RestrictedApplicationDto).

ApplicationKind.description: What an application is: an application proper, a message bus, a SaaS, a data store, a file exchange or a third party.

mode.description: Always `full`: the file describes the whole landscape it was exported from.

sensitivity.description: Most sensitive of the carried data objects (internal when there is none).

FlowDto.description: A flow the reader may see in full. `restricted` is always false (true on RestrictedFlowDto).

index.description: Position of the item in `items`, or null for an error on the envelope.

path.description: JSON path of the faulty value, e.g. `items[3].spec.fromId`.

applied.description: True when the changes were written (not a dry run, no error).

ImportResultDto.description: Outcome of an import (or of its dry run): counts of items, or the errors that stopped it (nothing written).

LandscapeDto.description:
Everything the explorer needs, in one call. `applications` holds ApplicationDto or
RestrictedApplicationDto items, `flows` holds FlowDto or RestrictedFlowDto items
(discriminated by `restricted`).

LandscapeStatsDto.description: Counts of what the landscape response holds.

errors.description: Field errors (field name in camelCase, then messages), on 400 only.

RestrictedApplicationDto.description: A restricted application, as seen by a reader who is not an administrator.

RestrictedFlowDto.description: A flow from or to a restricted application, as seen by a reader who is not an administrator.

Sensitivity.description: Ordered from the least to the most sensitive: the sensitivity of a flow is the maximum of what it carries.

password.description: New password; leave empty to keep the current one. Changing it closes the user's sessions.

Visibility.description: `Restricted` applications are only shown in full to administrators; others see their id and domain.
